meaning: Conditional attribution-order schema instance: an order by approach to a primary, universal possession of the selected perfection, and the unrestricted cause-more-such condition imply that a maximum has no distinct cause of that same perfection. Strict primacy and primary-causes-creatures are not used. This proves the conditional transfer, not its domain-specific hypotheses.
